title: Distributed Prediction under Heterogeneity with Unidentifiable Parameter
summary: Predicting a response based on covariates is a fundamental problem in statistics and machine learning. However, profound difficulties arise when the underlying low-dimensional structural parameters are unidentifiable, as typified in dimension reduction contexts. Specifically,estimating these non-identifiable parameters inherently introduces severe nonconvexity. In distributed settings, this difficulty is further compounded by the challenges of data heterogeneity and communication cost.
